_note: Seed for the boards. musashikosugi: shelters, their addresses and target areas were verified on 2026-11-02 against 川崎市地域防災計画 資料編 2-06 避難所（指定避難所）一覧表 (as of 令和7年4月1日) and 2-18 応急給水拠点 (https://www.city.kawasaki.jp/601/page/0000140630.html). shibuya: verified on 2026-11-04, target areas from 渋谷区地域防災計画（令和5年度修正）資料編 資料5 避難所一覧, names, addresses and closures from the 渋谷区 page 避難所・自主避難施設一覧 (updated 2026-07-03), shelters for stranded commuters from the 渋谷区防災ポータル list (updated 2026-07-21), the water station from 東京都水道局渋谷営業所 渋谷水道ミニ情報 令和7年9月号; docs/BOARDS.md and docs/DEVLOG.md give the URLs. Area codes come from e-Stat 小地域 boundaries (scripts/geo). The admin token is generated by scripts/seed.ts and printed once; only its hash is stored.
